title: Hozir davom etayotgan harakat
goal_uz: Dars oxirida hozirgi davomli zamon (am/is/are + -ing) bilan hozir nima bo‘layotganini aytasiz va so‘raysiz, oddiy hozirgi zamon bilan farqini ajratasiz, know, want kabi holat fe’llarini -ing shaklida ishlatmaysiz hamda rasmdagi olti kishining nima qilayotganini tasvirlay olasiz.

scenes.title: Hozir nima bo‘layapti?
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we will talk about actions happening now. What are you doing right now? You are learning English!
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ish va o‘qish hayoti haqida gaplashdik va oxirida hozirgi davomli zamon haqida gap ketdi. Bugun aynan shuni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida hozir nima bo‘layotganini ayta olasiz, “men ishlayman” bilan “men hozir ishlayapman” farqini ajratasiz va rasmdagi odamlarning nima qilayotganini tasvirlay olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun hozir bo‘layotgan harakatlar haqida gaplashamiz. Hozir nima qilyapsiz? Siz ingliz tilini o‘rganyapsiz!

scenes.title: Shakli: am / is / are + -ing
scenes.say: I am working. She is reading. They are waiting. It is raining.
scenes.say_native: Hozirgi davomli zamon ikki qismdan iborat: to be fe’li, ya’ni am, is yoki are, va asosiy fe’lga -ing qo‘shilgan shakl. I am working, she is reading, they are waiting. Bu zamon aynan hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi. O‘zbekchadagi “-yapman, -moqdaman”ga to‘g‘ri keladi: ishlayapman, o‘qiyapti, kutishyapti. Og‘zaki nutqda qisqartiramiz: I’m, she’s, they’re.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishlayapman. U o‘qiyapti. Ular kutishyapti. Yomg‘ir yog‘yapti.

scenes.title: -ing qo‘shish qoidalari
scenes.say: Work, working. Make, making. Run, running. Sit, sitting. Lie, lying.
scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik fe’lga oddiy -ing qo‘shiladi: work, working. Jim e bilan tugasa, e tushadi: make, making; write, writing. Qisqa fe’l undosh, unli, undosh bilan tugasa, oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: run, running; sit, sitting; swim, swimming. W, x, y ikkilanmaydi: playing, fixing. Ie bilan tugasa ying bo‘ladi: lie, lying. Britaniyada travel, travelling; Amerikada traveling.
scenes.say_uz: Ishlamoq, ishlayapti. Qilmoq, qilyapti. Yugurmoq, yugurayapti. O‘tirmoq, o‘tiribdi. Yotmoq, yotibdi.

scenes.title: Shakl xatolari
board: ✓ I'm working. She's working. He's running.
scenes.say: Not: I working. Say: I am working. Not: she is work. Say: she is working. Not: runing. Say: running.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: to be ni tushirib qoldirish, “I working”. O‘zbekchada “-yapman” fe’lga yopishgan, shuning uchun inglizchada ham alohida am, is, are kerakligi esdan chiqadi. Ikkinchisi: -ing ni unutish, “she is work”. Uchinchisi: ikkilanishni unutish, “runing”. To‘g‘risi running, ikkita n. Ikkala qismi ham bo‘lishi shart: to be va -ing.
scenes.say_uz: I working emas, I am working deng. She is work emas, she is working deng. Runing emas, running deng.

scenes.title: -ing shaklini yozing
scenes.say: Say the -ing form. Write. Make. Run. Sit. Swim. Lie. Tie. Play. Travel.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Fe’llarning -ing shaklini ayting va harflab yozib ko‘ring. Birinchi qator: write va make, e tushadimi? Ikkinchi qator: run, sit, swim, undosh ikkilanadimi? Uchinchi: lie va tie. To‘rtinchi: play va travel, Britaniya shaklida. Har birini baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: -ing shaklini ayting. Yozmoq. Qilmoq. Yugurmoq. O‘tirmoq. Suzmoq. Yotmoq. Bog‘lamoq. O‘ynamoq. Sayohat qilmoq.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Writing, making. Running, sitting, swimming. Lying, tying. Playing, travelling.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Write bo‘lsa writing, e tushadi. Make bo‘lsa making. Run, sit, swim fe’llarida undosh ikkilanadi: running, sitting, swimming. Lie va tie dagi ie yying bo‘ladi: lying, tying. Play oddiy: playing, chunki y ikkilanmaydi. Travel Britaniyada travelling, ikkita l bilan, Amerikada esa traveling. Xato qilgan fe’llaringizni daftarga yozib qo‘ying.
scenes.say_uz: Writing, making. Running, sitting, swimming. Lying, tying. Playing, travelling.

scenes.title: Inkor va savol
board: I'm not working. She isn't working.
Are you working? – Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Is he working? – Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
What are you doing? Where is she going?
scenes.say: I'm not working. She isn't working. Are you working? Yes, I am. What are you doing?
scenes.say_native: Inkor uchun to be dan keyin not qo‘yamiz: I’m not working, she isn’t working, they aren’t working. Savol uchun to be gap boshiga chiqadi: Are you working? Is he working? Qisqa javob: Yes, I am; No, he isn’t. Bu yerda do yoki does kerak emas, chunki yordamchi fe’l allaqachon bor, ya’ni to be. Savol so‘zi ham oldinga chiqadi: What are you doing? Where is she going?
scenes.say_uz: Men ishlamayapman. U ishlamayapti. Siz ishlayapsizmi? Ha. Nima qilyapsiz? U qayerga ketyapti?

scenes.title: Inkor va savol xatolari
board: ✗ Is she works? / Are you work?
✓ Are you working? He isn't working. Is she working?
scenes.say: Not: do you working. Say: are you working. Not: he doesn't working. Say: he isn't working.
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. Birinchisi: do you working. Do bilan -ing birga kelmaydi, chunki bu davomli zamon, yordamchi fe’l faqat to be. Ikkinchisi: he doesn’t working. To‘g‘risi he isn’t working. Uchinchisi: is she works. To be dan keyin oddiy fe’l emas, -ing shakli keladi. Qoidani eslab qoling: davomli zamonda faqat to be va -ing, do va does ishtirok etmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Do you working emas, are you working deng. He doesn't working emas, he isn't working deng.

scenes.title: Gap tuzing
scenes.say: Make sentences. She, cook. They, not watch TV. You, listen, question. What, he, do, question.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekrandagi so‘zlardan to‘liq gap tuzing. Birinchi: u ovqat pishiryapti, darak gap. Ikkinchi: ular televizor ko‘rmayapti, inkor gap. Uchinchi: siz tinglayapsizmi, savol. To‘rtinchi: u nima qilyapti, savol so‘zi bilan. To be ni gapning to‘g‘ri joyiga qo‘yishni unutmang va gaplarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Gap tuzing. U ovqat pishiryapti. Ular televizor ko‘rmayapti. Siz tinglayapsizmi? U nima qilyapti?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: She is cooking. They aren't watching TV. Are you listening? What is he doing?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: she is cooking. Ikkinchi: they aren’t watching TV, ya’ni they are not watching. Uchinchi savolda to be oldinga chiqadi: are you listening? To‘rtinchi: what is he doing? Bu yerda doing so‘zi ham -ing shaklida, chunki do asosiy fe’l. Savol so‘zi, to be, ega va asosiy fe’l tartibi: what is he doing. Bu tartibni yod oling.
scenes.say_uz: U ovqat pishiryapti. Ular televizor ko‘rmayapti. Siz tinglayapsizmi? U nima qilyapti?

scenes.title: Hozir va hozirgi payt
board: now, right now, at the moment
scenes.say: I'm studying English right now. She is working at the moment. Look! It's snowing. Listen! Someone is singing.
scenes.say_native: Hozirgi davomli zamon bilan ko‘pincha vaqt so‘zlari keladi: now, right now, at the moment, ya’ni aynan hozir. Kengroq ma’noda today, this week, these days, ya’ni shu kunlarda. Yana Look! va Listen! kabi undovlar, chunki ular ko‘rib turgan yoki eshitib turgan narsangizni bildiradi: Look! It’s snowing. At the moment Britaniyada juda ko‘p ishlatiladi. Bu so‘zlar odatda gap oxirida yoki boshida turadi.
scenes.say_uz: Men hozir ingliz tilini o‘rganyapman. U hozirgi paytda ishlayapti. Qarang! Qor yog‘yapti. Quloq soling! Kimdir qo‘shiq aytyapti.

scenes.title: Vaqtinchalik harakat
board: I'm staying with my uncle this week.
She's studying for her exams these days.
They're building a new school nearby.

examples.t: I'm staying with my uncle this week.

scenes.say: I'm staying with my uncle this week. She is studying hard for her exams these days.
scenes.say_native: Davomli zamon aynan shu daqiqada bo‘layotgan ishdan tashqari, vaqtinchalik davr haqida ham ishlatiladi. Masalan: I’m staying with my uncle this week, bu hafta amakimnikida turibman. She’s studying for her exams these days, shu kunlarda imtihonga tayyorlanyapti. Gap vaqtinchalik, ya’ni tez orada tugaydigan holat haqida. Doimiy holat bo‘lsa, oddiy hozirgi zamon: I live with my parents.
scenes.say_uz: Bu hafta amakimnikida turibman. U shu kunlarda imtihonlarga qattiq tayyorlanyapti.

scenes.title: Dialog: telefonda
scenes.say: Hello, Sam. Where are you? I'm on the train. I'm going to work. What are you doing? I'm reading my emails. And you? I'm walking to the station. It's raining and I'm not wearing a coat!
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Anna Samga qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi. Ular qayerda ekanini va nima qilayotganini aytishadi. Telefonda gaplashganda hozirgi davomli zamon eng ko‘p ishlatiladi, chunki “qayerdasan, nima qilyapsan” savollari doim hozirga tegishli. Savollarga qarab tinglang va javoblarni toping.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Sem. Qayerdasan? Poyezddaman. Ishga ketyapman. Nima qilyapsan? Elektron xatlarimni o‘qiyapman. O‘zing-chi? Bekatga piyoda ketyapman. Yomg‘ir yog‘yapti, men esa palto kiymaganman!

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
scenes.say: Four questions about the phone call.
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savol. Birinchi: Sem qayerda? Ikkinchi: u nimani o‘qiyapti? Uchinchi: Anna qayerga piyoda ketyapti? To‘rtinchi: Anna nima kiymagan? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan, hozirgi davomli zamonda ayting. Agar eslay olmasangiz, dialogni yana tinglang.
scenes.say_uz: Telefon suhbati bo‘yicha to‘rtta savol.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) She is walking to the station.
scenes.say: Sam is on the train. He is reading his emails. Anna is walking to the station. She isn't wearing a coat.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Sem poyezdda, he is on the train. U elektron xatlarini o‘qiyapti, he is reading his emails. Anna bekatga piyoda ketyapti, she is walking to the station. U palto kiymagan, she isn’t wearing a coat. Bu yerda ham hozirgi davomli zamon ishlatildi, chunki harakat gapirilayotgan paytda davom etyapti. Shunda ham tuzilma bir xil: ega, to be, -ing.
scenes.say_uz: Sem poyezdda. U xatlarini o‘qiyapti. Anna bekatga piyoda ketyapti. U palto kiymagan.

scenes.title: Qarang va ayting
board: the children — play in the garden
the cat — sleep on the sofa
scenes.say: Look at the picture. What are they doing?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Tasavvur qiling, siz derazadan qarayapsiz. Tom mashinani yuvyapti. Anna kechki ovqat pishiryapti. Bolalar bog‘da o‘ynayapti. Mushuk divanda uxlayapti. Har bir odam yoki hayvon nima qilayotganini to‘liq gap bilan, am, is yoki are ishlatib ayting. Bolalar va ular kabi ko‘plik egalar uchun are kerakligini unutmang.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmga qarang. Ular nima qilyapti?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: The children are playing in the garden.
The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
scenes.say: Tom is washing the car. Anna is cooking dinner. The children are playing in the garden. The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Tom is washing the car. Anna is cooking dinner. Bolalar ko‘plik, shuning uchun the children are playing, is emas. Mushuk bitta, the cat is sleeping. Ko‘plikda are, birlikda is. Oddiy qoida: ega nechta bo‘lsa, to be shunga mos keladi. Agar siz to‘rttasini ham to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, bu mavzuning asosiy qismini egalladingiz.
scenes.say_uz: Tom mashinani yuvyapti. Anna kechki ovqat pishiryapti. Bolalar bog‘da o‘ynayapti. Mushuk divanda uxlayapti.

scenes.title: Oddiy hozirgi va davomli: farq
scenes.say: I work in a bank. That is my job. I'm working now. That is what I am doing at this moment.
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim farq. Oddiy hozirgi zamon odat va doimiy faktlar uchun: I work in a bank, she drinks tea every morning. Davomli zamon hozir yoki vaqtinchalik bo‘layotgan ish uchun: I’m working now, she’s drinking tea. O‘zbek tilida “ishlayman” ikkala ma’noda ham ishlatilishi mumkin, inglizchada esa tanlash shart. “Men hozir ishlayman” deb inglizcha “I work now” desangiz, noto‘g‘ri chiqadi. To‘g‘risi I’m working now.
scenes.say_uz: Men bankda ishlayman. Bu mening kasbim. Men hozir ishlayapman. Bu aynan shu paytda qilayotgan ishim.

scenes.title: Signal so‘zlar
board: Simple: always, usually, often, every day, never
Continuous: now, at the moment, today, this week
scenes.say: I usually walk to work, but today I am taking the bus. It is raining.
scenes.say_native: Gapdagi vaqt so‘zi sizga qaysi zamonni tanlashni aytadi. Always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day odat bildiradi, bular oddiy hozirgi zamon bilan keladi. Now, at the moment, today, this week, look, listen hozirgi davomli bilan. Bitta gapda ikkalasi birga ham kelishi mumkin: I usually walk to work, but today I’m taking the bus. Bu odat va bugungi istisnoni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say_uz: Odatda ishga piyoda boraman, lekin bugun avtobusda ketyapman. Yomg‘ir yog‘yapti.

scenes.title: Zamonni adashtirish
board: ✗ He is playing football every Sunday.
scenes.say: Not: I read now. Say: I am reading now. Not: he is playing every Sunday. Say: he plays every Sunday.
scenes.say_native: Ikkita keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchisi: hozir bo‘layotgan ish uchun oddiy zamonni ishlatish, “I read a book now”. Bu yerda now bor, shuning uchun I’m reading. Ikkinchisi: odat uchun davomli zamonni ishlatish, “He is playing football every Sunday”. Every Sunday odatni bildiradi, shuning uchun he plays. Gapdagi vaqt so‘ziga qarab, ikkala holatni tekshirib turing.
scenes.say_uz: I read now emas, I am reading now deng. He is playing every Sunday emas, he plays every Sunday deng.

scenes.title: Qaysi zamon?
scenes.say: Choose present simple or present continuous. Number one, two, three, four.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklda yozing. Birinchi: u har ertalab qahva ichadi. Ikkinchi: jim bo‘ling, chaqaloq uxlayapti. Uchinchi: men bankda ishlayman. To‘rtinchi: qarang, yomg‘ir yog‘yapti. Har bir gapda signal so‘zlarga e’tibor bering: every morning, be quiet, look. Gaplarni to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Oddiy hozirgi yoki hozirgi davomli zamonni tanlang. Bir, ikki, uch, to‘rt.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: She drinks coffee every morning. The baby is sleeping. I work in a bank. It is raining.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: she drinks, every morning odatni bildiradi, uchinchi shaxs, shuning uchun s. Ikkinchi: the baby is sleeping, jim bo‘ling degan so‘z hozirgi payt haqida. Uchinchi: I work in a bank, bu doimiy ish. To‘rtinchi: it is raining, look degan so‘z ko‘rinib turgan hodisani bildiradi. Agar xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, signal so‘zni ostiga chizib mashq qiling.
scenes.say_uz: U har ertalab qahva ichadi. Chaqaloq uxlayapti. Men bankda ishlayman. Yomg‘ir yog‘yapti.

scenes.title: Doimiy yoki vaqtinchalik
board: I'm living with my aunt this month. (vaqtinchalik)
He's working in a café this summer. (yozgi ish)
scenes.say: I live in Tashkent. But this month I am living with my aunt. He works in a shop, but this summer he is working in a café.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir farq: doimiylik va vaqtinchalik. I live in Tashkent, men Toshkentda yashayman, bu doimiy. I’m living with my aunt this month, bu oy xolamnikida yashayapman, ya’ni vaqtinchalik. He works in a shop, bu uning odatiy kasbi, he’s working in a café this summer, bu yozgi vaqtinchalik ish. O‘zingizning hayotingizdan shunday juftlik toping, bu qoidani mustahkamlaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Men Toshkentda yashayman. Lekin bu oy xolam bilan yashayapman. U do‘konda ishlaydi, lekin bu yoz kafede ishlayapti.

scenes.title: Dialog: ofisda
board: Karim: Is Laura in the office?
Nina: No. She's working from home this week.
Karim: She usually works here, doesn't she?
scenes.say: Is Laura in the office today? No, she isn't. She's working from home this week because she's looking after her mother. Really? She usually works here every day. Yes, she does. Is she answering emails? Yes, she is. She's answering them right now.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog ofisda. Hamkasblar Laura haqida gaplashadi. Dialogda ikkala zamon ham bor: odat uchun oddiy zamon, shu haftaga tegishli vaqtinchalik holat uchun davomli zamon. Tinglang va qaysi gap qaysi zamonda ekanini payqang. Savollarga javoblarni toping.
scenes.say_uz: Laura bugun ofisda mi? Yo‘q. U shu hafta uydan ishlayapti, chunki onasiga qarab turibdi. Rostdanmi? U odatda har kuni shu yerda ishlaydi. Ha. U xatlarga javob yozyaptimi? Ha. Aynan hozir yozyapti.

scenes.title: Laura haqida savollar
board: 3) Where is she working this week?
scenes.say: Four questions about Laura.
scenes.say_native: Laura haqida to‘rtta savol. Birinchi: Laura ofisdami? Ikkinchi: u odatda qayerda ishlaydi? Uchinchi: shu hafta qayerda ishlayapti? To‘rtinchi: nima uchun? Ikkinchi savolga oddiy zamonda, uchinchisiga davomli zamonda javob bering. To‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Laura haqida to‘rtta savol.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: No, she isn't. She usually works in the office. This week she is working at home. She is looking after her mother.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Yo‘q, u ofisda emas, no, she isn’t. U odatda ofisda ishlaydi, she usually works in the office, bu odat. Shu hafta uyda ishlayapti, she’s working at home, bu vaqtinchalik. Sababi: onasiga qarab turibdi, she’s looking after her mother. Ko‘rdingizmi, bitta suhbatda ikkala zamon ham o‘z o‘rnida ishladi.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘q. U odatda ofisda ishlaydi. Bu hafta uyda ishlayapti. U onasiga qarab turibdi.

scenes.title: Davomli zamonda ishlatilmaydigan fe’llar
board: like, love, hate, want, need, prefer
scenes.say: I know the answer. I want a coffee. She likes music. We need help. I understand.
scenes.say_native: Ba’zi fe’llar harakat emas, holatni bildiradi. Ularni davomli zamonda ishlatmaymiz, hatto hozirgi paytda bo‘lsa ham. Bularga kiradi: know, understand, believe, remember, like, love, hate, want, need, prefer. Masalan, “men bilaman” — I know, “I’m knowing” emas. “Men qahva xohlayman” — I want a coffee. O‘zbekchada “bilyapman” desak ham bo‘ladi, inglizchada esa bunday qilib bo‘lmaydi, shuning uchun yodda tuting.
scenes.say_uz: Men javobni bilaman. Men qahva xohlayman. U musiqani yoqtiradi. Bizga yordam kerak. Men tushunaman.

scenes.title: Ikki ma’noli fe’llar: have va think
board: I have a car. (egalik) ✓  I'm having a car ✗
scenes.say: I have a car. I'm having lunch. I think it's a good idea. I'm thinking about my holiday.
scenes.say_native: Ba’zi fe’llar ikki xil ma’noda keladi. Have egalik bo‘lsa holat: I have a car, davomli bo‘lmaydi. Lekin have harakat bo‘lsa, ya’ni ovqatlanish, dush qabul qilish, yig‘ilish, davomli bo‘lishi mumkin: I’m having lunch, she’s having a shower, we’re having a meeting. Think fikr bildirsa holat: I think it’s good. O‘ylanish jarayoni bo‘lsa davomli: I’m thinking about my holiday.
scenes.say_uz: Mening mashinam bor. Men tushlik qilyapman. Menimcha, bu yaxshi fikr. Men ta’tilim haqida o‘ylayapman.

scenes.title: Holat fe’llaridagi xatolar
board: ✗ She is having a new phone.
✓ I want a coffee. I know the answer. She has a new phone.
scenes.say: Not: I'm wanting. Say: I want. Not: I'm knowing. Say: I know. Not: she is having a phone. Say: she has a phone.
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. Birinchisi: I’m wanting a coffee. To‘g‘risi I want a coffee. Ikkinchisi: I’m knowing. To‘g‘risi I know. Uchinchisi: she is having a new phone. Egalik haqida bo‘lgani uchun she has a new phone. Yodda saqlang: bilish, xohlash, yoqtirish kabi holat fe’llari doim oddiy hozirgi zamonda. O‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilar bunday xatoni tez-tez qilishadi.
scenes.say_uz: I'm wanting emas, I want deng. I'm knowing emas, I know deng. She is having a phone emas, she has a phone deng.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri yoki xato?
scenes.say: Correct or wrong? One, two, three, four. If wrong, say the correct sentence.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir gap to‘g‘rimi yoki xatomi, hal qiling. Xato bo‘lsa, to‘g‘ri variantini ayting. Birinchi: I’m wanting a coffee. Ikkinchi: she is having a shower. Uchinchi: they’re knowing the answer. To‘rtinchi: we’re having dinner. Fe’l holatni bildiradimi yoki harakatnimi, o‘ylab ko‘ring.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘rimi yoki xato? Xato bo‘lsa, to‘g‘ri gapni ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One, wrong: I want a coffee. Two, correct. Three, wrong: they know the answer. Four, correct.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi xato: I want a coffee, chunki want holat fe’li. Ikkinchi to‘g‘ri: she is having a shower, bu yerda have dush qabul qilish, harakat. Uchinchi xato: they know the answer. To‘rtinchi to‘g‘ri: we’re having dinner, ovqatlanish harakat. Demak, have ma’nosiga qarab ikkala shaklda ham kelishi mumkin, want, know esa hech qachon.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi xato: I want a coffee. Ikkinchi to‘g‘ri. Uchinchi xato: they know the answer. To‘rtinchi to‘g‘ri.

scenes.title: Ikki savol: do va doing
board: What do you do? = Kasbingiz nima?
What are you doing? = Hozir nima qilyapsiz?
Where do you work? = Qayerda ishlaysiz?
Where are you working today? = Bugun qayerda ishlayapsiz?
scenes.say: What do you do? I'm a teacher. What are you doing? I'm marking tests.
scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida eng chalkash savol juftligi. What do you do? deganda kasbingizni so‘rashadi, javob: I’m a teacher. What are you doing? deganda hozir nima qilayotganingizni so‘rashadi, javob: I’m marking tests, ya’ni daftarlarni tekshiryapman. Ikkalasi ham “nima qilasiz” deb tarjima qilinadi, lekin ma’nosi butunlay boshqa. Birinchisini tanishuvda so‘rashadi, ikkinchisini esa biror kishi bilan hozirgi paytda gaplashganda.
scenes.say_uz: Siz nima ish qilasiz? Men o‘qituvchiman. Siz hozir nima qilyapsiz? Men yozma ishlarni tekshiryapman.

scenes.title: Savol va javobni moslang
board: 1) What do you do?   2) What are you doing?
3) Where do you work?  4) Where are you working today?
a) I'm writing an email.  b) I'm a nurse.
c) At home today.  d) In a hospital.
scenes.say: Match each question with its answer. What do you do? What are you doing? Where do you work? Where are you working today?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir savolga mos javobni toping. Birinchi: What do you do? Ikkinchi: What are you doing? Uchinchi: Where do you work? To‘rtinchi: Where are you working today? Javoblar: a, men xat yozyapman; b, men hamshiraman; c, bugun uyda; d, kasalxonada. Savoldagi zamonga qarang: do doimiy, are doing hozirgi.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir savolni javobi bilan moslang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) What do you do? – b) I'm a nurse.
2) What are you doing? – a) I'm writing an email.
3) Where do you work? – d) In a hospital.
4) Where are you working today? – c) At home today.
scenes.say: One, b. Two, a. Three, d. Four, c.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: What do you do? — b, I’m a nurse. Ikkinchi: What are you doing? — a, I’m writing an email. Uchinchi: Where do you work? — d, in a hospital. To‘rtinchi: Where are you working today? — c, at home today. Ko‘rdingizmi, savoldagi bitta fe’l shakli javobning mazmunini belgilaydi. Savolni diqqat bilan tinglash tilni tushunishning yarmi.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi b. Ikkinchi a. Uchinchi d. To‘rtinchi c.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: qisqartmalar va -ing
board: What are you doing? → /wɒt ə ju ˈduːɪŋ/
scenes.say: I'm working. He's reading. They're waiting. What are you doing?
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzda uchta narsaga e’tibor bering. Birinchi: qisqartmalar. I’m, he’s, they’re deb aytamiz, to‘liq am, is, are deb emas. Ikkinchi: What are you doing? savolida are zaif aytiladi, deyarli “ə”: what-ə-you-DOO-ing. Uchinchi: -ing oxiridagi ng bu bitta tovush, “tong” so‘zidagi kabi, uning oxiriga alohida g qo‘shmang. Bu tovush o‘zbek tilida ham bor, shuning uchun siz uchun qiyin emas. Urg‘u fe’lning o‘ziga tushadi.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishlayapman. U o‘qiyapti. Ular kutishyapti. Siz nima qilyapsiz?

scenes.title: Qisqartib o‘qing
scenes.say: Say each sentence with a short form. She is eating. They are working. I am waiting. He is not sleeping.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekrandagi har bir gapni qisqartirib ayting. Birinchi: she is eating. Ikkinchi: they are working. Uchinchi: I am waiting. To‘rtinchi: he is not sleeping, bu yerda ikki xil qisqartish mumkin. Avval o‘zingiz urinib ko‘ring, keyingi qismda javoblarni eshitasiz. Ovozingiz tabiiy, bir oqimda chiqsin.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni qisqartirib ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 4) He's not sleeping. / He isn't sleeping.
scenes.say: She's eating. They're working. I'm waiting. He isn't sleeping. Or: he's not sleeping.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. She’s eating. They’re working. I’m waiting. He isn’t sleeping yoki he’s not sleeping, ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri. Mamlakatlararo farq yo‘q, ikkala variant ham ishlatiladi, faqat I’m not deyiladi, I amn’t emas. Yozma ish yoki rasmiy xatda to‘liq shaklni yozing, og‘zaki nutqda qisqa shakldan foydalaning. Shunda tabiiy eshitiladi.
scenes.say_uz: U ovqatlanyapti. Ular ishlayapti. Men kutyapman. U uxlamayapti.

scenes.title: Rasmni qanday tasvirlash
board: In the picture, there is / are ...
on the left / on the right / in the middle
next to / behind / in front of
A man is ... ing. Two boys are ... ing.
scenes.say: In the picture, a man is reading. On the left, a girl is drinking tea. Behind them, two boys are playing.
scenes.say_native: Rasmni tasvirlashda avval umumiy rasmni ayting: In the picture, there are six people. Keyin joyni ko‘rsating: on the left, on the right, in the middle, next to, behind, in front of. Keyin har kim nima qilayotganini hozirgi davomli zamon bilan ayting: a man is reading, two boys are playing. Har bir gapda ega va to be mos kelsin. Oxirida bir umumiy gap qo‘shing.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmda bir odam o‘qiyapti. Chap tomonda bir qiz choy ichyapti. Ularning orqasida ikki bola o‘ynayapti.

scenes.title: Namuna: parkdagi odamlar
board: In the picture, six people are in a park.
A girl is reading a book.
An old man is feeding the birds.
scenes.say: In the picture, six people are in a park. On the left, a girl is reading a book. Next to her, a man is drinking coffee. In the middle, two boys are playing football. A woman is taking photos of the trees, and an old man is feeding the birds. Nobody is running.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. Rasmda parkdagi olti kishi tasvirlangan. Avval umumiy gap, keyin chapdan o‘ngga qarab har kimning ishi. Hammasi sodda hozirgi davomli gaplar. Oxirida inkor gap ham bor: nobody is running. Sizning vazifangiz ham shunday: oltita odam, oltita gap va kamida bitta inkor gap. Namunani bir marta diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmda parkda olti kishi bor. Chap tomonda bir qiz kitob o‘qiyapti. Uning yonida bir erkak qahva ichyapti. O‘rtada ikki bola futbol o‘ynayapti. Bir ayol daraxtlarni suratga olyapti, qari kishi esa qushlarni boqyapti. Hech kim yugurmayapti.

scenes.title: Kafedagi odamlarni tasvirlang
board: 4) a man — read a newspaper; a baby — sleep
scenes.say: Describe the café. Use is or are and an ing form. Include one negative sentence.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz. Kafe rasmini tasavvur qiling. Ofitsiant likopchalar ko‘tarib yuribdi. Oshpaz sho‘rva tayyorlayapti. Ikki qiz choy ichyapti. Bir erkak gazeta o‘qiyapti, chaqaloq uxlayapti. Har bir odam uchun to‘liq gap tuzing va kamida bitta inkor gap qo‘shing, masalan: the baby isn’t crying. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Kafeni tasvirlang. Is yoki are va -ing shaklidan foydalaning. Bitta inkor gap ham qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: A man is reading a newspaper. The baby is sleeping.
scenes.say: The waiter is carrying plates. The cook is making soup. Two girls are drinking tea. A man is reading a newspaper. The baby is sleeping. The baby isn't crying.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javob. The waiter is carrying plates. The cook is making soup, bu yerda e tushadi: making. Two girls are drinking tea, ko‘plik, shuning uchun are. A man is reading a newspaper. The baby is sleeping. Inkor gap, masalan, the baby isn’t crying. Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi to be va -ing to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin. Xatolarni topib, qayta ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Ofitsiant likopchalar ko‘tarib yuribdi. Oshpaz sho‘rva tayyorlayapti. Ikki qiz choy ichyapti. Bir erkak gazeta o‘qiyapti. Chaqaloq uxlayapti. Chaqaloq yig‘lamayapti.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: now, at the moment, this week
scenes.say: Today you learned the present continuous: form, spelling, questions, time words, the contrast with the present simple, and state verbs.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Hozirgi davomli zamon am, is yoki are va -ing bilan quriladi. Inkor uchun not, savol uchun to be oldinga chiqadi, do kerak emas. Now, at the moment, this week kabi signal so‘zlar bor. Odat uchun oddiy hozirgi, hozir uchun davomli zamon. Know, want, like kabi holat fe’llari davomli bo‘lmaydi, have va think esa ma’nosiga qarab keladi. Siz endi rasmni tasvirlay olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun hozirgi davomli zamonning shakli, imlosi, savollari, vaqt so‘zlari, oddiy hozirgi bilan farqi va holat fe’llarini o‘rgandingiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
scenes.say: Your homework: describe what six people in a picture are doing now. See you next time!
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Biror rasm toping, masalan, ko‘cha yoki bayram rasmi, va undagi olti kishi hozir nima qilayotganini tasvirlang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: oltita to‘liq gap, har birida to‘g‘ri am, is yoki are va -ing shakli, kamida bitta inkor gap. Gaplarni yozing va ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Keyingi darsda biror ishni taklif qilish, rozi bo‘lish va rad etishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz: rasmdagi olti kishi hozir nima qilayotganini tasvirlang. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Rasmdagi olti kishi hozir nima qilayotganini tasvirlang: har biri uchun bittadan, jami oltita to‘liq gap, am/is/are + -ing bilan. Gaplarni yozing, so‘ng ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: oltita gap, har birida to‘g‘ri am/is/are va -ing shakli, kamida bitta inkor gap.

quiz.q: Listen! The children ___ in the garden.
quiz.why_uz: Listen! hozirgi paytni bildiradi; bolalar ko‘plik: are playing.
Write: oxirgi e tushadi va -ing qo‘shiladi: writing.
I bilan inkor: I am not (I'm not) working.
Davomli zamonda savol to be bilan: Are you listening?

quiz.q: My father ___ in a bank. It's his job.
quiz.why_uz: Doimiy kasb uchun oddiy hozirgi zamon: works.
Dush qabul qilish harakat, shuning uchun is having.
Know holat fe’li, davomli zamonda ishlatilmaydi.
What are you doing? Hozirgi davomli savol: are.

quiz.q: We usually walk to work, but today we ___ the bus.
quiz.why_uz: Today bugungi istisno; davomli zamon: are taking.

quiz.q: Which question asks about someone's job?
quiz.why_uz: Kasb haqida so’rash: What do you do?
